msgs:
ANOTHER YEAR OF
LAUGHS AND ADVENTURES

May everything
you dream of
come true

Today is
your day!
Relax and enjoy

Wishing you a
year full of
adventures

Wishing you a
cup overflowing
with joy

You make the
world better.
Happy birthday!

Congrats from
the bottom
of our hearts!

Lots of friends
and very few
worries

You only get
better with time

Happy birthday!
Stay just
as you are

Many years,
much happiness,
lots of cake!

Wishing you easy
roads and
true friends

Today you can
have a second
slice of cake

May dreams become
plans and plans
become real

It's not the years,
it's the joy
in them

The whole world
celebrates you
today

A year wiser,
a year
more fabulous

Blow out the
candles and wish
for the big thing

May this year
bring you
everything good

A truckload of
happiness and
two of health!

This will be
a great year!

New year of life,
new heights

May every day
feel like
a celebration

Wishing you a
warm and cozy
home

May life be as
sweet as
this cake

One more trip
around the sun! {y}

You know how
to make people
happy

May only
good news
call today

Years are a
collection of
good moments

Wishing you all
the tastiest things

Good luck in
your new year!

Wishing all your
dreams come true!

A home full
of guests
and laughter

Happy birthday!
May luck
follow you

The most
interesting part
is ahead

A year full of
good meetings

May your car
always start
first time

New roads and
a full tank!

All the best
and then some!

Wishing you quiet
evenings and
bright days

The whole day is
just for you

Make it a day
to remember

May all good
things come
back to you

May joy be
a daily thing

Another year of
love and care

Make a wish,
we'll handle
the cake

Birthday rules:
no chores, only fun
